source: Our World in Data — Energy dataset

note: Rebuilt by OWID from the Energy Institute Statistical Review of World Energy, Ember, the U.S. EIA and OWID population/GDP series. Detailed fuel and carbon-intensity coverage begins ~1965 (energy) / ~2000 (electricity mix, carbon intensity). Aggregates are OWID-defined; do not sum them.
